description: Public Roland/Boss Ballade SNG input fixtures used by Glosa's version-specific converter tests.

checks: Each checked-in SNG fixture converts to an SMF that SmfReader can read.
The generated sequence contains at least two tracks.
The v1 runner.SNG conversion has the expected tempo events at ticks 0, 8, and 192.
The v1 runner.SNG conversion has 3295 Note-on and 3295 Note-off events; this is a count check, not event-by-event equality.
A v1 no-change tempo-stream test retains the default 120 BPM tempo.
doesNotEstablish: Byte-for-byte equality with reference SMF files.
Complete event-by-event equality for every Ballade version.

privateReferenceValidation.note: Historical private-fixture CI results apply only to the Glosa commit tested by that run. Rerun the private workflow against a later commit before treating it as validated.

samples.verification: Public CI converts this fixture and reads the generated SMF with SmfReader. Separate tests check tempo-event byte sequences and Note-on/Note-off counts; there is no public event-by-event comparison against the reference MIDI.
Public CI converts this fixture and reads the generated SMF with SmfReader. This does not establish event-by-event equality with the private reference MIDI or playback equivalence.
